name: Data Recipe: Daily brand and competitor news alert

parameters.content:
## Daily brand & competitor news alert
Every morning the [Google News Scraper](https://apify.com/fast_data_asap/google-news-scraper) searches Google News for your brand and competitors (last 24 h). Articles you already got are dropped, the rest is posted as one digest to Slack (e-mail optional).

**Setup (5 min)**
1. *Search news*: Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer <Apify API token>`.
2. Put your brand and competitor names into `queries` (quotes = exact phrase).
3. *Post to Slack*: connect Slack and set the channel.
4. Optional: enable *Send e-mail* and add SMTP credentials.

Cost: $0.0025 per article. 2 queries x ~10 articles/day = about $1.50/month.

nodes.name: Search news
nodes.notes: Runs apify.com/fast_data_asap/google-news-scraper and returns its dataset. The JSON body is the Actor input - edit it freely.

nodes.name: Send e-mail
nodes.notes: Optional: enable and add SMTP credentials to get the digest by e-mail too.
